        fin_cases a <;>
          fin_cases b <;>
          fin_cases c <;>
          simp
    }
  map_one' := by
    ext b
    fin_cases b
    <;> simp
  map_mul' c b := by
    ext a
    fin_cases a
    <;> fin_cases b <;> fin_cases c
    <;> simp
